# BarcodeExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent extension methods for 1D barcodes.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`AltText`](#alttext): Sets the alternate text for accessibility (PDF/UA-1).
- [`BackgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Sets the background colour.
- [`DrawBackground`](#drawbackground): Toggles drawing of the background.
- [`ForegroundColor`](#foregroundcolor): Sets the colour of the bars.
- [`Height`](#height): Sets the height of the bars in points.
- [`ModuleWidth`](#modulewidth): Sets the width of the narrowest bar (one module) in points.
- [`QuietZone`](#quietzone): Sets the number of quiet-zone modules on each side.
- [`TextLabelFontSize`](#textlabelfontsize): Sets the font size of the human-readable text label, in points.
- [`WithTextLabel`](#withtextlabel): Toggles the human-readable text label beneath the bars.
